task_instance: A developer invokes ethos-orchestrate: 'Help me write an ETHOS.md for my agent.' I created a small realistic sample agent (an internal docs question-answering Slack bot, 'docs-qa', with a README and agent.yaml), routed per the orchestrate table to the explore+write sub-flows, and produced the resulting schema-v1 ethos.md at the sample agent's root.
blocker_detail: The bundled structural validator is a Python script and this office-assistant runtime cannot execute code, so it could not be run. This did not block the deliverable: the skill's own Troubleshooting prescribes, when the validator is unavailable, checking the file's structure against the template by hand and stating the check was not run. The validator's rules are simple and fully readable from its source, so I verified them manually.
evidence: Read SKILL.md (ethos-orchestrate) plus the referenced sub-flow ethos-write/SKILL.md, the schema-v1 template, and the bundled validator source. Created sample inputs: sample-agent/README.md and sample-agent/agent.yaml. Produced the deliverable at sample-agent/ethos.md (absolute path: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r055/sample-agent/ethos.md). Followed the standard: concrete one-sentence Role (hard requirement) drafted from code; sections only the user can establish (mission/outcome, principles, trade-offs ranking, vision) written as code-inferred drafts explicitly flagged as unconfirmed, with every gap recorded in Open Questions rather than fabricated; honest _(none)_ used in Metric Semantics. Verified structure by hand against the validator's documented rules: YAML front matter present; schema_version equals '1'; required non-empty keys name and author present; created_timestamp '2026-10-31T00:00:00Z' is ISO-8601 parseable; updated_timestamp omitted on first write; optional owner omitted (not empty-but-present, which the validator would reject); all fourteen required ## sections present exactly (Role, Purpose & Outcomes, Scope, Tools, Harness, Behavior, Principles, Success Criteria, Trade-offs, Constraints, Evaluation Setup, Metric Semantics, Vision, Open Questions) with no duplicates and no stray ## headings; the single-# title line is not matched as a section. The office-assistant's granted read/write/edit text abilities were sufficient to produce and structurally verify the ethos.md deliverable; only execution of the bundled Python validator was unavailable, and the skill explicitly supports that fallback.
